text:
deploy-bot: Initiating release run: release/2026-03-23. Orchestration: api@2.6.1 -> runtime@4.3.0 -> console@1.9.7 -> router@3.2.0. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> full.
maria: Heads-up: console requires feature-flag 'enable_runtime_header' before we swap router headers. @kevin can you flip at canary start?
kevin: Yep, I'll flip 5m before canary and run quick smoke. Plan: flip, run smoke tests (3x), then proceed. Rollback if any 5xx surge or token errors.
dan: Runtime note: kernel change includes new batching path + kv eviction tweak (kv_eviction=aggressive). Recommend pinning API version for 30m so KV warmup isn't evicted during early traffic.
sasha: Release notes pushed: https://internal/docs/releases/2026-03-23. Added a short rollback runbook and the post-release checklist.
maria: Proposed rollback criteria (for this release): any of:
- sustained 5xx rate > 3% for 10m
- token error rate > 1% for 5m
- p95 latency > 40% above baseline for 10m
Agree?
kevin: Agree. Also add: if model variant falls back more than 10% of requests for 5m, trigger rollback. I'll enable circuit-breaker route to stable variant.
ops-bot: Capacity reservation: +4 GPUs in eu-west1 for 60m starting 22:55 UTC.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (5%) starting now (ts=1719654321). Pinning api@2.6.1 for 30m.
dan: Pin command for ops if needed:
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/pin \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"service":"api","version":"2.6.1","ttl":"30m"}'
```
maria: Smoke checks after 4m: no 5xx, kv-hit-rate healthy, token errors 0.1%. :thumbsup:
kevin: Flipped feature-flag enable_runtime_header=true at 23:00:50 UTC. Verified via console.
dan: Observability: p50 up ~10% (expected), p95 within threshold so far. Watching token/sec and kv-hit-rate closely.
sasha: If we need to roll back: steps in runbook -> unpin api, flip flag off, route circuit-breaker to stable, scale down extra GPUs. I have the checklist ready.
maria: Starting ramp to 25% now (23:12 UTC).
deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% complete; traffic at 25%.
dan: Alert: p95 in eu-west spiked ~55% over baseline for 3 minutes. Error rate still low but latency spike breaches rollback threshold. Initiating rollback per criteria.
kevin: Acknowledged. Reverting flag and shifting traffic back to stable variant. 
kevin: Revert command: console feature-flag enable_runtime_header=false (done). Routing override to stable variant applied.
ops-bot: Releasing reserved GPUs at 23:20 UTC. Capacity released.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 rollback executed and traffic restored to stable set. Marking release as aborted.
sasha: Filing postmortem draft and tagging owners: runtime infra, kernel team, observability. Will include timeline and gaps in smoke-eval.
maria: Thanks all — good coordination. We'll re-run this with an extra preflight for kernel perf tests.
